description:
ROOTED IN YOGA. DEDICATED TO WELLBEING.

Myga is a growing wellness brand offering a thoughtfully curated range of yoga, Pilates, fitness, recovery and wellbeing products designed to support a healthy, balanced lifestyle.

From yoga mats and Pilates equipment to wellness journals, meditation accessories, recovery tools, hydration products, self-care essentials and wellness gummies, Myga helps people create positive habits that support both body and mind.

WHY PARTNER WITH MYGA?

• 10% commission on every qualifying sale
• 10% discount code for your audience
• 40-day cookie duration
• Average order value of £50+
• Monthly PayPal payouts (minimum £30 threshold)
• Product gifting opportunities for selected partners
• Priority consideration for events, classes and retreat collaborations

WHAT MAKES MYGA DIFFERENT?

Diverse Product Range
Promote a wide range of yoga, Pilates, fitness, recovery and wellness products, making it easy to find products that resonate with your audience.

Trusted Brand
Myga products are enjoyed by customers worldwide and are available through multiple retail, wholesale and online channels.

Regular New Releases
We continually expand our product range, providing fresh opportunities for content creation and promotion throughout the year.

Creator-Focused Partnerships
We value authentic, long-term relationships and work closely with creators, teachers, wellness professionals and community leaders who genuinely align with the Myga brand.

HOW WE SUPPORT OUR PARTNERS

• Product gifting opportunities for selected creators
• Product information and guidance when needed
• Access to approved brand assets and logo files
• Friendly support from the Myga team

If you're passionate about yoga, Pilates, fitness, wellness or self-care, we'd love to hear from you.

term_and_condition:
Welcome to the Myga Creator & Affiliate Programme.

These Terms and Conditions apply to all participants in the Programme. By applying to and participating in the Programme, you agree to comply with these Terms and Conditions.

The Programme allows approved partners to earn commission by promoting Myga products using their unique discount code. Selected partners may also be considered for gifted products, product testing and bespoke collaboration opportunities.

  1. Approval or Rejection of Applications

We reserve the right to approve or reject any application to the Myga Creator & Affiliate Programme at our sole discretion. We are under no obligation to provide a reason for any rejected application.

  1. Discount Codes and Promotion

Approved partners will be provided with a unique discount code to share with their audience. Commission will be awarded on qualifying purchases made using that code.

Partners may promote Myga through social media platforms, websites, blogs, newsletters, podcasts, classes, events and other appropriate channels.

Partners must not misrepresent Myga, make false claims about our products or present themselves as official representatives of the brand unless authorised by Myga.

  1. Commissions and Payments

Affiliates earn a 10% commission on qualifying purchases made using their unique discount code.

Commission is calculated on the order value excluding shipping charges, taxes and any refunded items.

Commission payments are made via PayPal once the minimum payout threshold of £30 has been reached. Affiliates are responsible for ensuring their payment details are accurate and up to date.

Orders that are cancelled, refunded or result in chargebacks will not qualify for commission.

  1. Marketing Materials

Affiliates are welcome to use product images and information available on the Myga website for promotional purposes. The Myga logo may also be provided upon request for approved promotional activities.


  1. Tracking and Cookies

The Programme uses tracking technology to attribute sales to affiliates. The current tracking period is 40 days from the customer's first interaction with an affiliate code or referral link.

If cookies are disabled or removed by the customer, tracking may not be possible and commission may not be awarded.

  1. Affiliate Partnership Guidelines

Customer Satisfaction
Myga takes great pride in the quality of our products and customer service. Affiliates should promote Myga in a professional and responsible manner that supports a positive customer experience.

No Brand Bidding
Affiliates are not permitted to bid on the keywords "Myga" or "Myga Yoga" in paid advertising campaigns, including Google Ads.

Truthful Promotion
Affiliates must not make false, misleading or unsubstantiated claims about Myga products.

Email Marketing
Promotional emails may only be sent to recipients who have provided appropriate consent in accordance with applicable laws and regulations.

No Spam or Fake Testimonials
Affiliates must not use spam, misleading marketing practices, fake reviews or fake testimonials to promote Myga.

Official Representation
Affiliates must not create the impression that they are acting as an official representative of Myga or that their content, website or social media channels are owned or operated by Myga.

Product Gifting & Collaborations
Selected affiliates may be offered gifted products, product testing opportunities or bespoke collaborations at Myga's discretion. These opportunities are not guaranteed and may be offered, modified or withdrawn at any time.

  1. Leaving the Programme

Affiliates may leave the Myga Creator & Affiliate Programme at any time by contacting contact@myga-yoga.com. Any approved commissions earned prior to leaving the Programme will be paid in accordance with the Programme's payment terms.

Myga reserves the right to suspend or remove any affiliate from the Programme at its sole discretion, including where these Terms and Conditions have been breached, where an account remains inactive for an extended period of time, or where participation is no longer considered to be in the best interests of the brand.

Thank You

Thank you for being part of the Myga Creator & Affiliate Programme.

We look forward to building a positive and rewarding partnership with you. These Terms and Conditions may be updated from time to time, and the latest version will always apply.

If you have any questions, please contact contact@myga-yoga.com.
